summary: Verstappen carries a grid penalty into Mexico City after a fiery practice collision with Lawson, sharpening the battle for championship supremacy at a track favoring aggressive racing. Hirakawa's unexpected debut for Haas adds unpredictability to the midfield fight, while Antonelli's illness clouds what could be his title-clinching weekend. A dominant Verstappen performance could seize momentum in the championship fight, or a stumble could hand rivals the opening they've been hunting.
